messages:
mina: Quick FYI 1: we just published redwood-docs-theme v0.4.0 to GitHub. Small release but nice polish for community sites. :sparkles:

release-bot: Release published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs-theme/releases/tag/v0.4.0 

omar: Nice! What's new at a glance?

mina: Key bits: improved responsive layout, lighter CSS bundle, built-in codeblock copy button, and an accessibility audit fix. Also added simple i18n placeholders for community translations.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for tag v0.4.0 (build 12108). Visual regression tests: baseline updated, no regressions.

devrel: Can we get a 1-line blurb we can put in the forum post?

sylvia: Copyable blurb: "redwood-docs-theme v0.4.0 1: faster load, better mobile layout, and improved accessibility defaults for community docs."

mina: Added a tiny usage snippet to the release notes for docs sites: 
```
# install theme
pip install redwood-docs-theme==0.4.0
# enable in mkdocs.yml
theme: redwood-docs
```

security: Note: we rotated a dev dependency that had a minor advisory; no user-facing impact. Tracking ticket INF-5064 opened.

devrel: Planning a short demo + migration walkthrough tomorrow at 9am PT for maintainers who host docs. Volunteers to demo?

omar: Happy to demo the responsive layout and the copy button.

mina: Thanks all 1. I'll post announcement to community channels after DevRel final copy-checks. :rocket:
